_about: Per-user mainframe settings. Copy this file to 'mainframe.config.json' in the same folder and fill in your own values. 'mainframe.config.json' is listed in .gitignore, so it stays on your machine and is never committed. boot.ps1 reads bitwardenEmail when the Bitwarden CLI needs a login; the MAINFRAME_BW_EMAIL environment variable overrides it.
